title: GDPR — Data Management
subtitle: Export or anonymize personal data of a specific user
lookup_desc: Enter a user ID and choose an action. You can find user IDs in the student or company applications list.
export_success: Personal data export has been queued
confirm_warning: IRREVERSIBLE action: personal data of user #{id} will be anonymized. This cannot be undone.
erase_success: User personal data has been anonymized
info: This section is for GDPR compliance. Export creates a JSON file with all personal data. Anonymization replaces personal data with generic values and revokes all access.
